Roche carbonatée construite par des colo: Carbonate rock built by colonies of corals and algae, forms massifs with high framework porosity.
Le calcaire récifal (boundstone) se form: Reef limestone (boundstone) forms by in situ accumulation of building organisms, creating primary porosity that is often excellent.

La houille (charbon) est un cas extrême: Hard coal is an extreme case of Type III source rock, generally generating gas rather than oil.

Le loess est un limon éolien caractérist: Loess is an aeolian silt characteristic of cold Quaternary periods, typical of the overburden in Northern European basins.
